config.description: Official I-JEPA algorithm adapted to the same ImageNet-100 images, ViT-S/16, 240px, batch64 and 100 epochs. This is not the published ImageNet-1K recipe or an equal-FLOP comparison.
differences_from_sepa: Official patch-level multiblock prediction, target LayerNorm and Smooth L1 loss.
Official 6-layer/384-width predictor, larger than SEPA's 2-layer/192-width predictor.
Official RandomResizedCrop scale 0.3-1.0, bilinear; no flip, color jitter or blur.
Official weight-decay exclusions and cosine schedule 0.04 to 0.4; linear EMA 0.996 to 1; no gradient clipping.
Peak LR, warmup fraction, batch, image IDs and epoch count matched to SEPA; this single run does not establish optimal I-JEPA hyperparameters.
Official bf16 autocast, FP32 parameters; final feature extraction and probes FP32. SEPA pretraining was FP32.
Manifest data adapter keeps the final short batch, deterministic per-image augmentation and per-batch masks; rejects overlap if the upstream sampler relaxes its constraint.

Final evaluation reuses SEPA's center-square bicubic resize, train-only feature standardization and frozen SGD LR0.005/200-epoch classifier. No official-validation-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.

v2_config.description: SEPA V2 screen. Three standard global I-JEPA batches alternate with one tile-local canonical-prediction batch. K0 and k3 differ only in the controlled permutation on local batches. The clean EMA teacher is global, all targets remain patch-level, and the official 6x384 predictor and optimizer recipe are unchanged.

shared.global_branch: unchanged official I-JEPA forward, masks, target, loss and update

local_branch.student: seven independent native 80px tiles; 25 patch tokens each; repeated local 5x5 PE; no slot identity
local_branch.predictor: unchanged official 6-layer 384-wide predictor; observed context PE and canonical target PE
local_branch.target: all 25 patch embeddings in each of two hidden noncenter canonical tiles
local_branch.loss: teacher output LayerNorm plus mean Smooth L1, identical to global branch

screen_evaluation.data: deterministic grouped 90/10 split of training manifest; conflicting duplicate groups excluded
